The panel is the dock's drawer, in the dock's own window (adr.rg.020, 19.9.2026): 470×44 closed, 640×664 open, snapped to the same corner, tabs in the drawer, four windows now. P2's exit criterion met on 19.9.2026: five concurrent CLI sessions run by the build agent in pseudo-terminals, five spool records with the same account-wide figures and per-session cost and context, the app's reader listing all five as Cli/Both. The spool moved from %APPDATA% to ~/.reviewglass/spool on 18.9.2026 (adr.rg.019): the Claude desktop app is packaged (MSIX) and virtualises AppData for every child it runs, so the Desktop sessions' hooks wrote where an app launched from the shortcut could not see; measured working across the boundary after the move (a real Desktop-session edit in the panel within the first poll). Rule from now on: the app under test is launched the way the owner launches it, never from the agent's shell. Session 4 opened 18.9.2026 with the plan agreed the night before: hook spike, P4, spec v3 (dock's Still decision and the recorder's removal deferred). The hook spike is done: hook-collector built (src-tauri/src/bin/hook.rs, installed as ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-hook.exe, configured as a PostToolUse hook in ~/.claude/settings.json) and PostToolUse measured to fire on BOTH surfaces (Desktop Code tab, entrypoint claude-desktop, 2.1.274; CLI print mode, entrypoint sdk-cli, 2.1.268). The hook is P4's primary trigger everywhere; the transcript's tool records are not needed; 6.1's 'CLI only' bracket around the hook was an assumption and moves in spec v3. The collector prunes events older than an hour. Then P4's core, built in the background (observed on the release build: an edit in the panel 0.23 s after the hook, +1 −1 rendered by diff2html, .env denied): the events reader consumes spool/events into ChangeEvents, diff-service runs git diff scoped to the path (denylist first, debounce per 300 ms tick, untracked shown as an addition, every other case a status with a reason), and the Diff tab renders the selected file's diff with diff2html. 94 tests. Session 3 (17.9.2026) opened from the four observations at the top of docs/CHANGELOG.md. Shipped: observations 2, 3 and 4 as one change. A freeze with no frame in hand lets one frame through before holding, so Still from the dock is no longer black; every ReviewGlass menu holds the engine and the rider while it is open, so the lens stays under its menu and a still taken from the menu is the frame that was right-clicked on; and the glass canvas is no longer wiped on every state change, the cause found under both the black still and the menu in the still. Verified on the release build over CDP and window rects (see the CHANGELOG for what was measured). The owner's second recording (50 s Follow) shows reading calm: no resize in 36 s of reading, the right edge held exactly; what remained was the trip to the dock, so Follow now holds while the cursor is over the dock (as over the glass), which also gives the dock's Still a meaning: freeze what the glass showed before the cursor left for the dock (to confirm with the owner, then an ADR). Session 2 (13.9.2026): adr.rg.017 pane detection with lock, Fit and the viewfinder; adr.rg.018 the dock, the panel as its drawer, the RG mark as a one-click switch, the global shortcut said and settable; the glass and the panel start hidden. Session 1 (11.-12.9.2026): from spec to a tool the owner uses, P0 spike, P1 magnifier, P2 session panel, P3 alerts, sixteen ADRs, docs to the family standard. Session 3 closed late on 17.9.2026 with the dock hold merged; the shortcut's exe is rebuilt from main but its dock hold was not checked on screen (no more live runs that evening).

deploy.surface: the owner's own Windows 11 machine only; no hosted component
deploy.binary: src-tauri/target/release/reviewglass.exe of the main checkout, launched from Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts; the build agent pulls and rebuilds it after every merge and verifies on warm launches; 23.9.2026 15:15: built from 23b2d01 (Follow chooses the session) and left running after the cursor check with WebView2 remote debugging on for that process only (a restart from the shortcut clears it); the panic log is merged after it and reaches the shortcut with the next rebuild
deploy.collector: ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-statusline.exe (statusLine) and ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-hook.exe (PostToolUse), both configured in ~/.claude/settings.json (backups: settings.json.bak-reviewglass-p0, -p4); the spool they write is ~/.reviewglass/spool (sessions/, events/) — never under AppData (adr.rg.019)
deploy.installers: NSIS and MSI both build; not yet used — P7
deploy.atlas: system reviewglass; status via atlas_put_status; MCP worker redeployed manually after each model merge (CI only dry-runs)

workflow: Code and docs in English, conversation in Finnish. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + pnpm check before every commit; CI on windows-latest runs the same. Commit straight to main while the repo is single-author (public since 17.9.2026); the Atlas model changes go through a PR on the Atlas repo, then wrangler deploy of the MCP worker. A new decision enters the Atlas model first and is rendered into docs/adr/ by node scripts/adr-from-model.mjs. End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
